resources.string:
In Termux:

1. pkg install tmux
2. echo "allow-external-apps=true" >> ~/.termux/termux.properties
3. termux-reload-settings
4. Tap "Open Claude" to start the tmux session (default name: claude).

The adb chip checks 127.0.0.1:5555 — run "adb tcpip 5555" from a computer after each reboot if it shows closed.
